Bavarian text:
Nochdem die Einwohnerzohl in die leschtn Joarzehnte kontinuierlich gsunken isch, steigt sie wieder, wos vor ollem der deitlichn Verjüngung der Stod zuazarechnen isch.

translation: After the population has continuously sunk in the last decades, it is rising again, which is to be attributed above all to the significant rejuvenation of the city.
